Ambrosial Nutraceuticals.note: Ambrosial Nutrifood operates independently under its founders Praveen Sharma and Swapnil Aggarwal, and has never been acquired.

BioSchwartz LLC.note: BioSchwartz was acquired via a buyout by GoodBio under PurpleRock Capital Partners in November 2019.

Codeage LLC.note: Life Extension completed the acquisition of Codeage LLC in September 2024.

Douglas Laboratories.note: Nestlé acquired Douglas Laboratories in December 2017 as part of its purchase of parent company Atrium Innovations.

HealthAid Ltd.note: PK Consumer Health signed an agreement to acquire HealthAid Limited in March 2026.

KAL.note: KAL was acquired by Nutraceutical Corporation (now part of The Better Being Co.) to expand its brand portfolio.

Mason Vitamins, Inc..note: Mason Vitamins was acquired by ITO EN (North America) Inc. in June 2006.

Nature's Answer, Inc..note: The business has remained family-owned since its founding in 1972.

New Leaf Products Ltd.note: In 2025, New Leaf P Holdings Ltd acquired a majority stake of 75% or more in New Leaf Products Ltd.

Nutraceutical Corporation.note: Nutraceutical Corporation, rebranded as The Better Being Co., was acquired by an investor syndicate led by Snapdragon Capital Partners in December 2025.

Organika Health Products Inc..note: The founding Chin family acquired the company via a management buyout from private equity firm BRS & Co. in 2024.

Purely Optimal LLC.note: Smart for Life, Inc. executed a definitive agreement to acquire Purely Optimal Nutrition in 2024.

Smart Vit Company.note: Smart Vit Company operates independently as a dietary supplement brand in Saudi Arabia, and there is no record of an acquisition.

Thorne.note: Procter & Gamble entered a definitive agreement to acquire Thorne from private equity firm L Catterton in 2026.
